summary.tldr: Authorizes $10.85 billion from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for federal public service expenses in 2025-26.
what_it_does: Authorizes $10,848,320,356 to be paid out of the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the federal public service.
Covers public service expenses that were not otherwise provided for in the financial year ending 31 March 2026.
Gives the Act force on Royal Assent, which it received on 11 December 2025.
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the House of Commons on 9 December 2025 and received Royal Assent on 11 December 2025.
